title: 第一篇 入世 二十一章 奇遇归来三月闲 参加比武入主峰第一篇 入世 二十二章 主峰山下好热闹 吕纯赛上试禁药
content_zh:
在云浪真人的一路叮嘱下，两人也来到了北峰峰下，向吊桥前去。乌凡越走越心慌，伸出一只手在前面摸索着，生怕撞到那看不见的法阵之上。云浪真人见状，嘴角微微一笑，不知从哪掏出一个白色的珠子，只见那珠子散发出淡淡的光芒，将二人笼罩，就这样一步一步的走出了北峰，却丝毫没受到阻拦。
见已经来到了吊桥前，乌凡心里不禁暗暗称奇，回头看了一眼北峰，又赶忙跟上云浪真人离去了。看见四周依然安静和谐，乌凡这一个月来的遭遇仿佛不曾在这里发生过，如同一场被拉长的时间的梦。
一个月的练石早已结束，九院的弟子也已踏入了正轨，虽然表面上是入门弟子，天天也有训练。可是除了训练之外，基本上都是干一些杂役的活计。玉壶宗北峰现在一共有十个院，两两一组，每次干活的时候也经常能见到其他院的弟子，时间长了也都能打个招呼。因为之前的九院是吴昊一干弟子，因为种种原因一个人都没剩下，所以每次别院弟子见到他们时，都是颇为关照。
虽然才过了不久，但是这些九院的弟子们也早已习惯了这日常的生活，只是每每望着那个空屋，不免心中多了一分不甘与无奈。而这个时候，众人早已聚集到了十院，看看有什么帮的上的，一起准备晚餐。
袁褚无精打采的侧头耷拉在桌子上，看着门外发呆，突然神情一怔，赶紧起身：“参见师尊！”然后众人也是放下了手中的活，集合到大厅内。云浪真人左右看了看，然后说道：“我之前来本是想通知你们关于三个月宗门比武的事情，可有急事处理，这次是来和你们仔细的说一说具体的事情。”
众人一听宗门比武，便来了精神，听着云浪真人说道：“这次宗门比武，事关重大，我们要选出四名弟子去参加泱都城的‘古门大选’，所谓古门就是上古一直流传下来的门派，比如我们玉壶宗，和之前遇到过的剑星居，以及太一阁，碧匣谷，金沙寺，当然虽然说是古门，但也有一些江湖异人，小门小派参与。而且每次这种大选，也难免会遇到邪门歪道参与进来扰乱，如果你们有幸能在宗门比武胜出一定要多加小心，就算没胜出也没关系，只要取得一个好名次不仅仅为东峰带来名声，也为自己带来一番机遇，而且大选之后还会有进一步的安排，到时候你们自然会知道。”
言罢，众人皆是沉默不语，在思考着什么。“对了，因为你们前些日子缺了一名宗门弟子，我给你们寻了一人回来，快进来和大家打个招呼。”听见真人这话，众人皆是满脸好奇，都抬起头向门口望去，只见门口一个熟悉的身影，带着一脸尴尬的笑容，走了进来。
众人一看皆是满脸激动，这不是小凡哥吗？难道他没死？都迫不及待的围了上去仔细打量一番。可是只见袁褚扯着嗓子就嚎了起来：“小凡哥你死的好惨啊！我知道你不甘心的嘛，你就放心的去嘛，我们会给你烧纸的！”霍福操起勺子就敲在他脑袋上，“你瞎哭丧啥玩仍？这个小凡哥是活的！不对！小凡哥没死！”
袁褚闻言，凑到近前，颤颤抖抖的伸出手放在乌凡鼻子前感受一下，好像还真有气儿。赶紧把乌凡抱住，“太好了！小凡哥！我就知道吉人自有天相的嘛。”“你再不松开，我就被你勒死了…”袁褚赶紧不好意思的松开了乌凡，又絮絮叨叨的和他说起了最近的事情。
云浪真人见状，也不再忍心打扰，看见他们那高兴的样子，眼神里多了一丝欣慰，心里却不由得生出了一分落寞。居高位虽然引人羡慕，可是再也回不到以前那种三五好友，互相插科打诨，毫无顾忌随心自然的感情了。
正所谓是：路见他乡落檐鸟，忙递新雀归旧巢。任它堂前雀儿闹，我自孤心远蓬蒿。
袁褚给乌凡絮絮叨叨之后，乌凡也将自己这一月所经历的事情，用和云浪真人所讲的那一番话，又重复了一遍，谎话说了二遍就顺口了起来。乌凡竟还加了一些生动的词语，将所经历的是讲的十分生动。让众人如同听书一般，是暗暗叫好，高呼过瘾！
本来众人还想让乌凡演示一下土诀，可是大家都肚子咕咕叫了，只能先作罢。而后便匆匆的吃了晚饭，在众人强烈要求下，而其中尤其是袁褚叫的最欢。乌凡心思一动，一念土诀，一根柱子直接勾住了袁褚的衣服把他带到了两丈高。袁褚吓得哇哇大叫，众人逗得哈哈大笑。
又折腾了一会乌凡有些累了，告辞了各位他便和九号院的弟子们一同回去了，回到屋子，竟感觉很是整洁，仿佛天天被人在打扫，乌凡心里十分感动。这么多日子里，悬着的心终于是可以放下了，乌凡只感觉眼皮越来越沉，然后就躺下睡着了。
第二天起来，乌凡醒来时发现众人早早的起身集合锻炼了，这么多日子过去竟然还没懈怠，而且愈发有模有样了。乌凡便上前一个个指导一下不规范的动作，也加入了他们的行列。
听说九号院那位被放到北峰的弟子居然活着回来了，东峰可算是热闹起来了。每次遇到别院弟子，那些人都像看到宝贝一样，两眼放光，上前拍拍他的身子，摸摸他的脸蛋，让乌凡心中十分痛苦。
好在好奇心来的快去的也快，众人见乌凡也是两只眼睛一张嘴，两条胳膊两条腿，时间长了也就不那么好奇了，只是每每遇到他的时候总会和他打招呼，“信凡哥，得永生！”也成为了他们的座右铭。
三个月的时间，转眼就过去了，乌凡对于五行诀也是信手拈来。尤其是土诀在云浪真人的指导下，他掌握了一些意想不到的窍门，对于使用法诀的气力也把握的很精准。了解了所谓的力气和气力也不是一回事，但还好有些相通，倒没什么大问题，所以暂且不提。
这日他们刚刚起床，就见外面有一弟子匆匆赶来，原来是宗门比武来临，让他们每院选出两名弟子，到东峰门口集合，然后就走了。众人商议了一下，乌凡肯定是首要人选，然后第二个人便犯了难题，这时听边上的一人说：“哎，小忠子，你家里不是练武的吗？干脆你和凡哥去吧，你觉得怎么样？”
只见边上一个小个子一脸难为情的说道：“家父虽然是位武师，也教我功夫，可他嫌我笨，我挨打的本事倒是不小，打人我害怕…”乌凡心想这些人里也只有这个小忠子底子不错，虽然说此人胆子小，但是却也有些拳脚功夫，于是说道：“赵孝忠你不要怕，实在不行就认输，反正去比武也没什么坏处，出了事我担着。”

赵孝忠咬咬牙，说道：“既然小凡哥都这么说了，我也不怕了，大不了就是挨顿揍！以后回去我也可以吹牛说我参加过比武大赛，看看谁喊我赵孝忠是赵小虫！”然后在众人的加油鼓励中，乌凡和赵孝忠便朝东峰门口走去。
东峰门口已经有几位弟子在那里等着了，见乌凡带着个小个子过来了，便笑着和他们打了声招呼，乌凡和他们简单的聊了几句就一齐等着剩下弟子的到来。这时只听不远处传来一声吼叫：“凡哥！来啦！哎哟！”只见霍福一脚踢在袁褚屁股上，引得众人哈哈大笑，乌凡满脑子黑线，心想果然十号院是这俩活宝来了。
走到近前，袁褚低头一看就乐了，“哈哈，小虫也来了嘛！不怕被逮去喂鸟吗？”因为平时都混熟了，对于这群师兄弟的称呼，赵孝忠倒是不在意，所以袁褚也开了个玩笑。乌凡闻言，瞪了袁褚一眼，装作不高兴的样子说：“我们院本来就不好找人，你给我把小忠子吓跑了，要是一会师尊问起来，我把你分成两份怎么样？”袁褚嘻嘻一笑：“小凡哥你要是把我分成两份，我另一份也想在十院歇着，你还是得在你们九院找人。”
就在众人笑闹间，东峰的十院二十名弟子都到齐了。过了没多久，只见云浪真人从峰门慢慢走来，大家便赶紧安静了下来等待下一步指示。云浪真人见众人都到了，就对他们讲道：“这次宗门比武，我们东峰十院一共二十，西峰二十院四十人，南峰二十院四十人，一共整整百人参加，最后取前五优胜者，参加古门大选。南峰实力虽然强劲，但我们也不要有丝毫的胆怯，我们并非没有一战之力，反观吕纯肯定会暗中做些手脚针对我们，所以要多加小心。西峰虽然实力不济，但在吕纯的‘教导’下倒是眼高手低，既然他们要针对我们，倒不如我们打它个措手不及，一雪前耻！而且这次优胜者有丰厚的奖励，对于自己的峰门也有很好的宣传作用，大家要努力要搞好名次，为自己的将来打好基础！但最终最重要的还是保护好自身安全！”
听到云浪真人的话，众人也是心潮澎湃，仿佛已经看到了吕纯满脸铁青的样子，恨不得比武马上开始。云浪见众人也有了斗志，微微点头，带着一群人向玉壶宗的主峰浩荡前行，乌凡微微握紧的双手终于就要揭开玉壶宗主峰的神秘面纱！
content_en:
Under the guidance of Master Yunlang, the two of them also arrived at the foot of Beifeng Peak and headed towards the suspension bridge. Wu Fan became more and more panicked as he walked, and stretched out a hand to fumble in front, for fear of bumping into the invisible magic circle. When Master Yunlang saw this, he smiled slightly and took out a white bead from somewhere. The bead emitted a faint light and enveloped the two of them. He walked out of Beifeng step by step without being blocked at all.
Seeing that he had arrived in front of the suspension bridge, Wu Fan couldn't help but secretly marvel. He looked back at Beifeng, and then hurriedly followed Master Yunlang and left. Seeing that the surroundings were still quiet and harmonious, it seemed as if what Wu Fan had experienced in the past month had never happened here before, like a dream that had been stretched out over time.
A month of stone training has long ended, and the disciples of the Ninth Academy have also stepped onto the right track. Although they are superficially entry-level disciples, they still train every day. But apart from training, they basically do some chores. Yuhu Sect North Peak now has a total of ten courtyards, which are divided into groups of two. Every time I work, I can often see disciples from other courtyards, and I can say hello after a long time. Because the former Ninth Academy was a group of disciples of Wu Hao, and for various reasons no one was left, so every time the disciples from other courtyards saw them, they were very considerate.
Although it has only been a short time, these disciples of the Ninth Academy have already become accustomed to this daily life, but every time they look at the empty room, they can't help but feel a little more unwilling and helpless in their hearts. At this time, everyone had already gathered in the Tenth Courtyard to see if there was anyone who could help and prepare dinner together.
Yuan Chu lowered his head listlessly on the table, staring at the door in a daze. He suddenly became startled and stood up quickly: "See Master!" Then everyone put down their work and gathered in the hall. Master Yunlang looked around, and then said: "I came here to inform you about the three-month sect martial arts competition, but I have something urgent to deal with. This time I am here to talk to you about the specific matters in detail."
As soon as everyone heard about the sect competition, they became energetic and listened to Master Yunlang say: "This sect competition is of great importance. We have to select four disciples to participate in the 'Ancient Sect Election' in Yangdu City. The so-called ancient sects are sects that have been handed down from ancient times, such as our Yuhu Sect, the Jianxingju that we have encountered before, as well as Taiyi Pavilion, Bixia Valley, and Jinsha Temple. Of course, although it is said to be an ancient sect, there are also some rivers and lakes. Strangers, small sects and small factions will participate. And every time there is an election like this, there will inevitably be evil factions involved. If you are lucky enough to win in the sect competition, you must be more careful. Even if you don’t win, it doesn’t matter. As long as you get a good ranking, it will not only bring fame to Dongfeng, but also bring you some opportunities. There will be further arrangements after the election, and you will naturally know it by then. "
After saying that, everyone was silent, thinking about something. "By the way, because you were missing a sect disciple a few days ago, I have found someone for you. Come in and say hello to everyone." Hearing the real person's words, everyone looked up with curiosity and looked up at the door. They saw a familiar figure at the door walking in with an embarrassed smile.
Everyone's faces were full of excitement when they saw it. Isn't this Brother Xiao Fan? Isn't he dead? They all couldn't wait to gather around and take a closer look. But Yuan Chu howled at the top of his lungs: "Brother Xiao Fan, you died so miserably! I know you are not willing to accept it, so just go and go with peace of mind, we will burn the paper for you!" Huo Fu picked up a spoon and hit him on the head, "What are you doing crying in mourning? This brother Xiao Fan is alive! No! Brother Xiao Fan is not dead!"
Hearing this, Yuan Chu came closer, tremblingly stretched out his hand and put it in front of Wu Fan's nose to feel it. He seemed to be really energetic. He quickly hugged Wu Fan and said, "That's great! Brother Xiao Fan! I know that Ji people have their own destiny." "Don't let go., I was strangled to death by you..." Yuan Chu quickly let go of Wu Fan in embarrassment, and talked to him about recent events.
When Master Yunlang saw this, he no longer had the heart to disturb them. When he saw their happy looks, there was a hint of relief in his eyes, but he couldn't help but feel a little lonely in his heart. Although being in a high position makes people envious, they can never return to the old feelings of being friends with each other, making fun of each other, and having no scruples.
As the saying goes: On the road, I saw a bird that had fallen off its eaves in a foreign country, and I was busy passing the new bird back to its old nest. Let the birds make noise in front of the hall, but my lonely heart is far away from the grass.
After Yuan Chu rambled on to Wu Fan, Wu Fan also repeated what he had experienced this month in the same words he told Master Yunlang. After telling the lie twice, he became smoother. Wu Fan actually added some vivid words to describe what he experienced very vividly. It made everyone just like listening to a book, secretly applauding and shouting that it was so enjoyable!
Originally, everyone wanted Wu Fan to demonstrate the earth technique, but everyone's stomachs were growling, so they had to give up first. Then they ate dinner in a hurry. At the strong request of everyone, Yuan Chu was the most happy among them. Wu Fan's mind moved, and as soon as he thought about the earth secret, a pillar directly hooked Yuan Chu's clothes and brought him to a height of two feet. Yuan Chu screamed in fright, making everyone laugh.
After struggling for a while, Wu Fan felt a little tired. He said goodbye to everyone and went back with the disciples in Courtyard No. 9. When he returned to the house, he felt very clean, as if someone was cleaning it every day. Wu Fan was very moved. After so many days, he could finally let go of his worries. Wu Fan felt his eyelids getting heavier and heavier, and then he lay down and fell asleep.
When Wu Fan woke up the next day, he found that everyone had gotten up early to gather for exercise. After so many days, he still hadn't slacked off, and he was becoming more and more impressive. Wu Fan stepped forward to guide each of their irregular movements and joined them.
I heard that the disciple who was sent to the North Peak in the No. 9 Courtyard actually came back alive, and the East Peak became lively. Every time he met a disciple from another academy, those people would look like they were seeing a treasure, their eyes would light up, they would step forward to pat his body and touch his face, which made Wu Fan feel very painful.
Fortunately, curiosity comes and goes quickly. When everyone sees Wu Fan, he also has two eyes, one mouth, two arms and two legs. As time goes by, they are no longer so curious. They just always say hello to him every time they meet him, "Brother Xin Fan, get eternal life!" ” has also become their motto.
Three months passed in the blink of an eye, and Wu Fan mastered the Five Elements Jue at his fingertips. Especially for Tujue, under the guidance of Master Yunlang, he mastered some unexpected tricks, and he also grasped the power of using the techniques very accurately. I understand that the so-called strength and vigor are not the same thing, but fortunately they are somewhat similar, so there is no big problem, so I won’t mention them for now.
As soon as they got up that day, they saw a disciple coming hurriedly outside. It turned out that the sect competition was coming, and they were asked to select two disciples from each house, gather at the gate of Dongfeng, and then leave. After everyone discussed it, Wu Fan was definitely the first candidate, and then the second person ran into a problem. At this time, they heard a person next to them say: "Hey, Xiao Zhongzi, isn't there a martial arts practitioner in your family? Why don't you and Brother Fan go? What do you think? "
I saw a little man next to me saying with an embarrassed face: "Although my father is a martial artist and taught me kung fu, he thinks I am stupid. I am quite capable of being beaten. I am afraid of beating people..." Wu Fan thought that this was the only one among these people. This little loyal guy has a good foundation. Although he is said to be timid, he also has some boxing skills, so he said: "Zhao Xiaozhong, don't be afraid. If you can't do it, just admit defeat. There is no harm in going to a martial arts competition anyway. I will bear the responsibility if anything happens." "
Zhao Xiaozhong gritted his teeth and said, "Since Brother Xiaofan has said so, I'm not afraid anymore. The worst I can do is get a beating."beat! When I go back in the future, I can brag that I participated in a martial arts competition and see who calls me Zhao Xiaozhong or Zhao Xiaochong! "Then with everyone's cheers and encouragement, Wu Fan and Zhao Xiaozhong walked towards the entrance of Dongfeng.
There were already several disciples waiting at the gate of Dongfeng. Seeing Wu Fan coming with a small man, he smiled and said hello to them. Wu Fan briefly chatted with them and waited for the remaining disciples to arrive. At this time, a roar was heard not far away: "Brother Fan! Coming! Ouch! "Huo Fu kicked Yuan Chu in the butt, causing everyone to laugh. Wu Fan's mind was full of dark thoughts, thinking that these two living treasures were indeed in No. 10 Courtyard.
When he came closer, Yuan Chu lowered his head and looked happy, "Haha, the little bug is here too! Aren't you afraid of being caught feeding the birds? "Because they were all familiar with each other, Zhao Xiaozhong didn't care about the names of these brothers, so Yuan Chu also made a joke. When Wu Fan heard this, he glared at Yuan Chu, pretending to be unhappy and said, "It's not easy for us to find people in our hospital. You scared Xiao Zhongzi away for me. If the master asks later, how about I divide you into two parts?" Yuan Chu chuckled: "Brother Xiaofan, if you divide me into two parts, and my other part wants to rest in the Tenth Courtyard, you still have to find someone in your Ninth Courtyard." "
While everyone was laughing and joking, all twenty disciples from the Tenth Academy of Dongfeng arrived. Not long after, Master Yunlang was seen walking slowly from the peak gate, and everyone quickly calmed down and waited for the next instruction. When Master Yunlang saw that everyone had arrived, he said to them: "For this sect competition, there will be a total of twenty from our East Peak Tenth Ward, forty from the West Peak Twentieth Ward, and forty from the South Peak Twentieth Ward. A total of one hundred people will participate. In the end, the top five winners will participate in the ancient sect general election. Although Nanfeng is strong, we should not be timid at all. We are not without the strength to fight. On the other hand, Lu Chun will definitely do something secretly against us, so we must be more careful. Although Xifeng is weak in strength, under Lu Chun's 'teaching', it seems that they have high ambitions and low intentions. Since they are going to target us, it is better for us to catch them off guard and avenge their previous shame! Moreover, the winners this time will receive generous rewards, which will also have a good publicity effect on their own peaks. Everyone should work hard to achieve a good ranking and lay a solid foundation for their future! But in the end, the most important thing is to protect your own safety! "
Hearing Master Yunlang's words, everyone's hearts were surging, as if they had seen Lu Chun's livid face, and they were eager for the competition to begin immediately. Yun Lang saw that everyone also had fighting spirit, nodded slightly, and led a group of people to march towards the main peak of the Yuhu Sect. Wu Fan's slightly clenched hands were about to finally reveal the mystery of the main peak of the Yuhu Sect!
